commits.message: Use one validation call per tap

files.flow.md: A tap sends one validation call. A timeout returns an uncertain result; do not charge twice.
A tap retries validation once after a timeout with the same tap id. The reply can arrive after the kiosk has shown an uncertain result.

files.worker.md: The worker records one receipt per accepted tap id.
The worker records one receipt per accepted tap id. Diagnostic labels include kiosk id.
